course_name_original: Garantía de la Calidad en los Laboratorios de Análisis Químico
course_name_en: Quality Assurance in Chemical Analysis Laboratories
prerequisites: It is recommended to have passed the subjects "Química" and "Ampliación de Química".
It may be difficult to follow some aspects of the subject if "Experimentación en Análisis Instrumental" and "Análisis Industrial y Medioambiental" are not being taken simultaneously.

learning_outcomes.text: Demonstrate knowledge of the basic aspects of quality control in laboratories.
Organize and manage the quality department of an analysis laboratory.
Validate an analytical method established in a laboratory.
Plan and correctly carry out the sampling corresponding to an industrial or environmental analysis.

syllabus_topics: Organization and infrastructure of laboratories in quality systems
Quality in the field of analytical laboratories
Selection and validation of analytical methods

assessment_methods.method: Work in classroom practices and group tutorials (questions and problems, preparation, active participation)

assessment_rules: For ordinary enrollment, the final grade is calculated as 0.9 * Final Exam + 0.1 * Classroom Practices and Group Tutorials. A minimum of 4 out of 10 must be obtained in both the final exam and the classroom practices/group tutorials. If either part does not meet the minimum of 4, the final grade will be the minimum of the calculated grade and 4. A minimum overall score of 5 out of 10 is required to pass. For extraordinary exams, a global exam covers 100% of the content and requires a minimum of 5 out of 10 to pass.
bibliography: "Garantía de la calidad en los laboratorios analíticos". Autores: Ramón Compañó Beltrán y Ángel Ríos Castro. Editorial Síntesis, Biblioteca de Químicas. ISBN: 84-9756-024-8.
institution: Universidad de Oviedo - Grado en Ingeniería Química Industrial (EPI Gijón)
